text: あなたは　どんな　ふうに　ポケモンを　そだてて　いるの？

structure.jp: ポケモンを　そだてて　いるの？

patterns.name: 〜ふうに
patterns.explanation: ふうに means 'in such a way'; with どんな it asks how. どんな　ふうに = 'in what way'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: A て verb plus いる shows something that is going on now. そだてて　いる = 'are raising'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end with a rising voice makes a soft, friendly question. そだてて　いるの？ = 'are you raising them?'
